title: Remote viewing God as a target

tellings.quote: >> And when I came out of the session and they opened the envelope, it said, "God."

plain: Sometime in the 1980s, a remote viewer in a military unit was given a sealed envelope as a target to describe with the mind alone, and when it was opened after the session it read "God." Lyn Buchanan, an Army sergeant who worked as a remote viewer in that unit, tells this first-hand, as a session he did himself.
